name: photo-ink-echo
title_zh: 原片在上、水彩记忆在下
tagline_zh: 不裁原图、不堆滤镜，只取照片里的 2~4 个淡色线索，在下半幅晕成一片未完成的水彩。适合安静归档。
tagline_en: No cropping, no filters. It distills 2–4 faint color cues from your photo into an unfinished watercolor strip.
desc_en: Transform one user-provided photograph into a restrained 9:16 editorial diptych with the untouched original photo above and a very small source-derived watercolor memory motif below.
